findings.highlight: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.
findings.evidenceJa: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
findings.governingReading: 脇に抱える is holding the wrapped Azoth sword under or beside the arm.
findings.explanation: Cloth-wrapped sword held at side becomes kept on waist.

findings.highlight: You don't need to be a mage to sense the ominous feeling of countless curses suffusing the air .
findings.evidenceJa: 夥しいまでの“呪い”を帯びた大気は、魔術師でなくとも、この場の不吉性を感じ取れる。
findings.governingReading: Source sentence ends normally after sensing ominous air.
findings.explanation: Stray space before sentence-ending period.

findings.highlight: "No, we're not going to the temple. The compound up top was built just for show, for the benefit of Masters seeking the Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 「いいえ、柳洞寺に用はないわ。上で作られてる場は表向きの、ただ聖杯を欲しがるマスター用の門よ。
findings.governingReading: Rin calls the upper constructed site the outward gate for Masters seeking the Grail, contrasted with underground Greater Grail.
findings.explanation: Upper site’s gateway function disappears.

findings.highlight: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.
findings.evidenceJa: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
findings.governingReading: Even descending almost cliff-like rock faces occurred; ほとんど modifies the sheer-cliff comparison, not how often they descended.
findings.explanation: Occasional nearly sheer descent becomes mostly small cliffs.

findings.highlight: It's flowing from several piles of rocks, and we finally come across an opening that one person can fit through.
findings.evidenceJa: 流れの源では幾つもの岩が折り重なり、人間一人がようやく入れる程度の隙間がある。
findings.governingReading: 人間一人がようやく入れる程度 describes a gap barely large enough for one person.
findings.explanation: Barely fitting opening becomes finally discovering one.

findings.highlight: When I go inside, I nearly run into a big stone, and it doesn't look big enough to fit a person.
findings.evidenceJa: 中に入ったところですぐに岩にぶつかると一目で判り、まっとうな人間なら入ろうとすら思わない。
findings.governingReading: At a glance one can tell entering would immediately meet rock, so an ordinary person would not even try.
findings.explanation: Visible hypothetical obstruction becomes enacted near collision.

findings.highlight: "The Jeweled Sword. How did you make it?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「宝石剣。なんで作ってくれたの」
findings.governingReading: なんで作ってくれたの asks motive for making it for her; she then explains her intent to kill Sakura.
findings.explanation: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.

findings.highlight: It's as wide as the school grounds.
findings.evidenceJa: 横幅は学校のグラウンドほど。
findings.governingReading: 学校のグラウンド is the school sports ground or field, used as width comparison.
findings.explanation: School playing field becomes school grounds.

findings.highlight: stands Saber, waiting for us.
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対の殺気を纏って、セイバーが待っていた。
findings.governingReading: She waits wrapped in 絶対の殺気.
findings.explanation: Saber’s absolute killing intent is omitted.

findings.highlight: After a big sigh, Tohsaka walks toward Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: ……大きく息を吸った後、遠坂はセイバーへと歩きだした。
findings.governingReading: 大きく息を吸った is taking a large breath before advancing.
findings.explanation: Deep inhalation becomes a sigh.

findings.highlight: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.
findings.evidenceJa: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou reads her encouragement as come while she can keep Sakura stopped or contained.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

findings.highlight: ...This battle isn't a contest of sword skills at all.
findings.evidenceJa: ……この戦いは、剣技を競うところからなど始まらない。
findings.governingReading: He must first find an opening; the fight does not start from straightforward competition of sword skill.
findings.explanation: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.

findings.highlight: "...Because I decided so. I will give you time to approach me.
findings.evidenceJa: 「……それが決まりですから。貴方が前に踏み出すまでは猶予を与えます。
findings.governingReading: それが決まりです refers to the rule; reprieve lasts until he steps forward.
findings.explanation: Rule-bound reprieve becomes Saber’s decision and approach allowance.

findings.highlight: But it will end there. I will not let you go to Sakura. I don't need to move. You will run out of patience and attack me."
findings.evidenceJa: ですが、それもじき終わる。貴方は桜の下に行くしかない。私が動くまでもなく、貴方の方が耐えられずに仕掛けてくる」
findings.governingReading: 貴方は桜の下に行くしかない explains why he cannot wait indefinitely and must attack.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.

findings.highlight: What is she surprised at?
findings.evidenceJa: 驚きはどちらのものか。
findings.governingReading: どちら asks which of the two owns the astonishment.
findings.explanation: Whose surprise is unresolved becomes Saber’s surprise.

findings.highlight: I have her on the defense.
findings.evidenceJa: 防戦一方。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is wholly on defense; only his opening attack was allowed, after which he keeps blocking Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defensive struggle becomes Saber under his assault.

findings.highlight: I'm having an actual dual against Saber!
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はあのセイバーと、こうしてマトモに打ち合えている—！
findings.governingReading: He rejoices in actually exchanging blows with Saber.
findings.explanation: Duel misspelled dual.

findings.highlight: Saber's attack hurls me backward, and I have to plant my feet behind me to regain my footing.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの一撃に大きく弾かれた俺は、仕切り直す為に背後に跳んだ。
findings.governingReading: After being strongly knocked back, he jumps farther back to reset the exchange.
findings.explanation: Deliberate backward jump becomes planting feet.

findings.highlight: But Sakura's alone, Tohsaka will definitely...
findings.evidenceJa: けど、逆に—桜一人なら、遠坂は必ず—
findings.governingReading: 逆に桜一人なら gives the conditional contrast: if Rin only faces Sakura.
findings.explanation: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.

findings.highlight: Let Two Great Men Share a Life
findings.evidenceJa: 両雄倶別命
findings.governingReading: 別命 and later 命ヲ別ツ retain separation or parting of life/fate in the two-hero line.
findings.explanation: Separate lives or fates become sharing a life in sword verse.

findings.highlight: I close in on the enemy, having thrown my only weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: 唯一の武器を手放したオレに、敵が間合いを詰めてくる。
findings.governingReading: 敵が間合いを詰めてくる after he throws away the weapons.
findings.explanation: Enemy closes on weaponless Shirou becomes Shirou closing.

findings.highlight: She just blocked ambushes from behind and a full-power frontal attack, all at the same time.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後からの奇襲と、全力で放った一撃を同時に敵は防いだ。
findings.governingReading: At this stage the original thrown Kanshou returns from behind while frontal Bakuya is broken; the second rear Bakuya arrives on135.
findings.explanation: One rear ambush becomes multiple in the first simultaneous defense.

findings.highlight: I have nothing else.
findings.evidenceJa: つまり、その先はない。
findings.governingReading: Paragraph explains the enemy’s limit and exposed state: she has nothing beyond that defense at this instant.
findings.explanation: Enemy has no further movement becomes boy has nothing else.

findings.highlight: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)
findings.evidenceJa: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
findings.governingReading: Ruby われら、ともにてんをいだかず invokes mutual noncoexistence under one heaven, alongside the separating-lives base line.
findings.explanation: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.

findings.highlight: Kanshou and Bakuya pierced her armor and rent her torso. The shock of it all the way into her spine.
findings.evidenceJa: 鎧を貫通した干将と莫耶は容赦なく彼女の胴を薙ぎ、衝撃は背骨にまで届いていた。
findings.governingReading: 衝撃は背骨にまで届いていた says impact reached the spine.
findings.explanation: Spine-impact clause lacks a verb.

findings.highlight: ...He reached his limits, and stepped beyond them.
findings.evidenceJa: ……限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの。
findings.governingReading: 限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの contrasts two conditions or parties, naturally Saber versus Shirou in this ending.
findings.explanation: Those staying at limit versus going beyond become one man’s progression.

findings.highlight: She doesn't care which way the scales will tip.
findings.evidenceJa: 天秤がどちらに傾いたかなど、彼女には関心がない。
findings.governingReading: どちらに傾いたか refers to which way the scales have tilted after the distant vibration.
findings.explanation: Already tilted scales become future tipping.

findings.highlight: It isn't perfect, but right now, my skills are close to that of Archer.
findings.evidenceJa: 完全じゃないが、今の衛宮士郎の技量はアーチャーのソレに近い。
findings.governingReading: His current skill approaches Archer’s, imperfectly.
findings.explanation: Plural skills compared with singular that.

findings.highlight: Even the greatest swordsman can't escape being flanked on both sides by steel-shattering Noble Phantasms.
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄塊をも撃ち砕く宝具の一刀を左右同時に見舞われては、いかな豪傑であろうと無傷では済まされない。
findings.governingReading: 無傷では済まされない says even a great warrior cannot escape the two powerful simultaneous attacks unscathed.
findings.explanation: Cannot remain uninjured becomes cannot avoid being flanked.
